deploySafety.summary: The reviewed diff is safe to restart ai.anicca.franklin-loop into production, CONDITIONAL on the two required post-restart steps below. Rationale: (1) the money/identity-critical paths (Solana secret derivation, per-instance identity gating, private-key non-leakage) were independently traced by hand, not just trusted from test output, and are structurally sound; (2) the shared anicca-daemon.sh's changes are provably no-ops for automaton (com.anicca.daemon) and founder-loop (ai.anicca.founder-loop) -- both consumers were discovered and checked directly, not just the one the manifest named; (3) this feature's blast radius is bounded to balance-read/tier-selection, never fund transfer; (4) worst-case failure mode on THINK routing is unchanged from today (wake_error, retry next wake, no crash) and is very likely IMPROVED since ClawRouter+free/glm-4.7 is the SAME already-proven-in-production path automaton already uses successfully, replacing a model that is empirically ~50% rate-limited today (315 wake_error lines observed live in the current ledger).
requiredPostRestartSteps: Immediately after restart, verify PROP-014 (no ANICCA_BALANCE_OVERRIDE in the live process env) and PROP-015(ii)/016(ii) (OPENAI_BASE_URL resolves to :8402 and no BLOCKRUN_WALLET_KEY present) via `launchctl print gui/$(id -u)/ai.anicca.franklin-loop` and/or `ps eww <pid>` -- these Tier-0 checks were not yet verifiable pre-restart (FIND-003) and are the actual production-truth gate, not the plist file alone.

Observe at least 3 consecutive wakes in ~/.blockrun/state/ledger.jsonl post-restart with no new wake_error/proxy_down lines and currentTier reaching lean/funded (PROP-006/009/010/011) before treating this feature as fully Done.
